cases.note: Passes in the starter. Only checks that DarkRP, FAdmin and CAMI exist.

cases.id: case:S: a job that does not exist cannot be made a hitman team
cases.note: Group S. DarkRP.addHitmanTeam(99999) must leave getHitmanTeams()[99999] nil. The call is not wrapped in pcall, so a fix that raises an error also fails.

cases.id: case:S: a real job can still be made a hitman team
cases.note: Passes in the unchanged starter (starter.execution.json): registering an existing job as a hitman team already works. It is also the positive boundary of the #5103 fix (a 'refuse everything' fix must not pass), hence overlap.

cases.id: case:T: a usergroup change reports the group the player came from
cases.note: Group T. Async, bot. Drives the FAdmin setaccess command callback and observes the (from, to) pair through a replaced CAMI.SignalUserGroupChanged.

cases.id: case:U: cleaning up a prompt that is already gone does not error
cases.note: Group U. pcall(DarkRP.destroyQuestion) with two unknown ids.

cases.id: case:V: demoting someone who is not here names who was looked for
cases.note: Group V. Async, bot. Calls the /demote callback for a name nobody has and requires a DarkRP.notify message that contains that name.

cases.id: case:X: removing a job takes its vote command with it
cases.note: Group X. Async (registration of team commands is deferred a frame upstream).

cases.id: case:Z: removing an ammo type removes that one and no other
cases.note: Group Z. Creates two ammo types, removes the second by its id, requires it gone and its neighbour kept.

cases.id: case:AA: a shipment category and its weapon copy do not share members
case:BB: re-declaring a category keeps what was already in it
cases.note: Group BB. Uses the entities kind.

cases.id: case:CC: dropped money survives an invalid physics object
cases.note: Group CC. pcall of spawned_money ENT.Initialize on a stand-in whose GetPhysicsObject returns NULL.
Static preflight: darkrp/gamemode exists, no symlinks, no native modules, no harness-tampering tokens.

clauses.anchor: Problem, report [#5102]: staff-audit addon sees 'beforehand' identical to 'moved them to' when a player's permissions are changed
clauses.note: Asserted for the setaccess command only. The identical read-after-write defect in FAdmin.Access.SetRoot (setroot) is fixed by the reference but has no case.

clauses.anchor: Problem, report [#5103]: a hitman team can be registered against a job number nothing uses; 'It used to refuse this.'
clauses.note: Negative half is the target case; the positive half already holds in the starter and is the preserved case.

clauses.anchor: Problem, report [#5104]: removing built-in buy-menu entries removes different ones instead
Problem, report [#5105]: 'attempt to index a nil value' when a yes/no popup is answered twice or its initiator has left
clauses.note: Checked as 'destroying an unknown prompt does not error'. The positive path (a live prompt is removed and its client panel is closed) is not asserted; a DarkRP.destroyQuestion that does nothing at all passes.

clauses.anchor: Problem, report [#5106]: /demote answers with gibberish when the demote does not land on anybody
clauses.note: Requires the not-found notification to contain the searched name.

clauses.anchor: Problem, report [#5107]: a removed job leaves its /vote... command behind
Problem, report [#5108]: two buy-menu lists are tied together; adding to or removing from one affects the other
clauses.note: Only the add direction shipments -> weapons is observed; removal and the weapons -> shipments direction are not. With a shared members table they are the same fault, so the single observation is discriminating for the injected defect.

clauses.anchor: Problem, report [#5109]: declaring the same buy-menu heading twice drops everything already filed under it
clauses.note: Observed for the entities kind only.

clauses.anchor: Problem, report [#5110]: something that comes off a player ends up half set up with a Lua error
clauses.note: Observed for spawned_money ENT.Initialize with an invalid physics object; see known_issues for the stand-in trap.

clauses.anchor: What to do, Notes bullet 4: 'Behaviour that already works must keep working - several of these live next to code paths that are fine.'
clauses.note: One starter-passing case (a real job can still be made a hitman team) checks one working path next to one defect. The working paths next to the other eight defects (e.g. removing a job still removes its own command, the first-declared category still sorts, demote of a present player) are not asserted.

clauses.anchor: What to do, Notes bullet 2: 'Fix the causes. Do not paper over a symptom by catching an error and discarding it, and do not special-case the exact scenario in a report.'
clauses.note: No case distinguishes a root-cause fix from a pcall wrapper: U and CC only require 'does not error'. Excluded: not observable by the suite.

clauses.anchor: What to do, Notes bullet 3: 'Do not change anything under /tests, and do not add test files of your own to the gamemode.'
clauses.note: Process constraint. /tests is not in the submission; the nearest gate is the static harness-tampering preflight in check:submission-shape (plugins/garrys-mod/src/rhenium_garrys_mod/darkrp/evaluator.py:287-336), which rejects Lua naming the test harness but not test files in general. Excluded from contract analysis.

known_issues: Fixture trap in group CC (benchmarks/darkrp-core/private/harbor/darkrp-live-server-regressions/tests/suite.lua:174-180): the stand-in's PhysicsInit returns true while GetPhysicsObject returns NULL, which the engine does not produce. A fix that keys the wake on the result of DarkRP.ValidatedPhysicsInit instead of phys:IsValid() is correct in the engine but fails. (Demonstrated on the same construction in darkrp-release-regressions-v3, control alternative-strict-reading.)

Group T observes the signal by replacing the table field CAMI.SignalUserGroupChanged (benchmarks/darkrp-core/private/harbor/darkrp-live-server-regressions/tests/suite.lua:61-68), not by listening to the public hook CAMI.PlayerUsergroupChanged that the reporting addon uses. A fix that caches the CAMI function in a local at load time, or that calls hook.Call('CAMI.PlayerUsergroupChanged', ...) itself, reports the right group to addons but is not seen. The command error is also swallowed by pcall (suite.lua:66), so a crash shows up as 'sawTo is nil' rather than as an error.
Group T covers only setaccess; the same defect in FAdmin.Access.SetRoot (environment/darkrp/gamemode/modules/fadmin/fadmin/access/sv_init.lua:203-206) is unasserted, so a half fix passes.

Group U (benchmarks/darkrp-core/private/harbor/darkrp-live-server-regressions/tests/suite.lua:76-80): in the starter DarkRP.destroyQuestion errors for EVERY id because 'question' is an undefined global (environment/darkrp/gamemode/modules/voting/sv_questions.lua:53-60), yet only the unknown-id path is asserted. An empty function body passes.

Group V captures feedback only through DarkRP.notify (benchmarks/darkrp-core/private/harbor/darkrp-live-server-regressions/tests/suite.lua:89-94); a readable message sent another way (ChatPrint, DarkRP.talkToPerson) fails. The reference's extra '#args == 0' guard in Demote is unasserted.

The preserved case 'S: a real job can still be made a hitman team' requires getHitmanTeams()[t] to be exactly true (benchmarks/darkrp-core/private/harbor/darkrp-live-server-regressions/tests/suite.lua:43-49) and relies on DarkRP.createJob returning the team number, which already holds on this base commit.

validation/per-defect-matrix.md (fix S/T/U/V/X/Z/AA/BB/CC each alone -> 3 PASS) was produced before the runner-collector replacement; validation/rhenium-controls.md re-ran only base, reference and the result-mutation probe for this task under the Rhenium plugin. The single-group target-negatives of this study are therefore the first per-group evidence on the current evaluator.
